tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database with users and tasks tables including indexes and relationships
Build Node.js/Express REST API with endpoints for task CRUD operations and user authentication
Implement React components for Task List screen with task cards, empty state, and floating action button
Create Task Creation screen with form validation, character counters, and error handling
Build Task Detail screen with mark complete, delete functionality, and confirmation modal
Implement Completed Tasks screen with strikethrough styling and clear all functionality
Design and implement bottom navigation component with active state indicators
Apply responsive design styles, color scheme, typography, and accessibility features across all screens
Implement user authentication flow with login/logout and session management
Create User Profile screen with statistics display and settings options
Add animations for screen transitions, button feedback, and task completion with reduced motion support
Conduct end-to-end testing of all user flows and fix critical bugs

risks: Database connection issues or performance bottlenecks with PostgreSQL queries may delay backend development
Form validation complexity and edge cases could extend frontend development time beyond estimates
Accessibility compliance testing may reveal issues requiring significant rework of UI components
Authentication implementation may introduce security vulnerabilities if not properly reviewed
Cross-browser compatibility issues could emerge late in development requiring additional fixes
